title: A revalidation window that starts at a heading line still fails section_unchanged when an unrelated H2 is added, renamed or removed
goal: factdiff.window_sections leaves out the parent's section, which hashes every sibling heading line, for a window that starts at a heading line (anchor heading = the parent's path) or runs into the next heading, with or without the previous text, so adding, renaming or removing an unrelated H2 does not fail section_unchanged, while an edit to the window's own heading or body still does; tools.md's claim that such a heading edit moves none of them then holds. Found by the SP-vk3wf746 review (S3, factdiff.py:272).

run:
import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import factdiff as f;old='# Guide

## Alpha

Alpha body.

## Beta

Beta body.

## Gamma

Gamma body.
';new=old+'
## Delta

New section.
';k=f.window_sections({'heading':'Guide','sha':'x'},f.Doc(new),None);r=f.section_unchanged(k,f.sections(old),f.sections(new));print(r);sys.exit(0 if r else 1)
